answer: Trying costs $61 in fees and a 26-day delay before the stamp dries a name, and the money is gone whether the name passes or fails. The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. One name, one proof, one entry: Dorsetbound cheshire carrier whey licence enforces it, and a licence cheshire carriers carry after cheese shop audits is how the check runs. The farm's purse empties long before its list of names does. The tally keeps walnut. The clerk notes mesa. The ferrous is on the docket.
